capabilities: Track tasks as Markdown checklists in daily, weekly, monthly and yearly notes
Organize tasks into projects and areas
Time tasks and events with timestamp bullets
Write time reports, timesheets and draft invoices from time entries
Sync calendar events into daily notes as checkboxes
disambiguation: Not a daily-note template or plain-text theme; it is a planner that adds time tracking, timesheets and invoices to periodic notes.
extras: No account, payment, ads or telemetry; calendar links are kept in each device's secret storage, and the settings copy includes them, so it should be kept private. The repository doubles as a demo vault with invented data.
problem: Planning, time tracking and invoicing sit in separate apps, so the record of what was done and billed is not kept in the vault's own Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: Templater runs the Templater code in your own templates for task notes, logs, projects, areas and periodic notes.
Notebook Navigator gives the periodic notes a calendar, new project and area folders their look
Natural Language Dates (Revived) reads dates in languages other than English
Task Status adds a picker for a task's checkbox
Selectable Tables allows you to set a default for frozen header rows and columns
Projects and areas organize tasks, as in Things and the PARA method.

requires.name: Google Calendar, iCloud or Outlook calendar with a private iCal link

summary: Markdown planner that tracks tasks, projects and time in periodic notes and turns timestamps into timesheets and invoices.
